articles.title: Hamilton takes first pole for Ferrari at Mexico City Grand Prix
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton takes his first pole position for Ferrari and his first for more than three years at the Mexico City Grand Prix.

articles.title: On 'tense' Antonelli's big weekend, this was Hamilton's day
articles.description: As Kimi Antonelli bids to become F1's youngest world champion, veteran Lewis Hamilton rolled back the years to take his first Ferrari pole.

articles.title: Ocon denies reports of physical altercation behind dropping
articles.description: Esteban Ocon denies reports that his being dropped by Haas at the Mexico City Grand Prix was a consequence of a row with team principal Ayao Komatsu descending into a physical confrontation.
